items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: she brought her son in, Ollie, and we had both of her kids and her too at the house.

ctx.x: She met me in Chicago, but she had talked with my wife about her five year old daughter. She had a son too. My wife (inaudible) take care of her because she loved kids. (Inaudible) and she brought [P_________] with her, and my
wife just fell in love with her and took care of her, and Boo stayed with me two years. And we kept -- and the son finally come, and we kept him too, Ollie.
How old was Boo then, her late '20s or early '30s?
